recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast double exposure merging a close-up male portrait with the weathered facade of a wooden house, utilizing a warm, sepia-heavy color palette and tight, geometric sans-serif typography at the top edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Portrait features aligned with architectural windows
Horizontal wood grain texture masking the facial highlights
Tight typographic header spanning the full width of the composition
Dark, vignetted edges framing the central illuminated subject
coreInvariants: Warm sepia and deep brown tonal range

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is centered and oversized, filling approximately 60% of the frame, superimposed over a two-story wooden structure.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned near the center-right, serve as the primary focal point through the house's upper windows.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold header text, drops to the central face, and follows the wood grain texture to the darker corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the bottom corners and the dark sky area provide breathing room for the complex central texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep Umber and Burnt Sienna (Shadows and Wood)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm Cream and Pale Yellow (Highlights and Skin Tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast, creating a moody, vintage atmosphere.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight letter spacing (touching or near-touching)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Interlocking or ligated letter pairs to save space
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold, large display header paired with much smaller, light-weight sans-serif columns for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric circularity and tight-fitting capability of the era.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a double exposure image where a close-up soulful male face is blended with a weathered, dark wooden house. Use a sepia and dark brown color palette. Ensure the wood grain is visible across the face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of bold, white geometric sans-serif text across the very top edge. Use extremely tight tracking so letters nearly touch. Add two small columns of light-weight white text in the upper left and right corners below the main header.

verificationChecks: Is the face clearly visible through the wood texture?
Is the header text justified to the full width of the frame?
Is the color palette restricted to warm browns and creams?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the wood grain texture
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Record label logos and catalog numbers
Specific window placement of the original house
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the subject's eyes
Check that the wood grain follows a consistent horizontal direction
Verify that the white text is legible against the dark background
Confirm the absence of any modern digital artifacts
recipe.reuseFormula: Double Exposure [Subject] + [Texture/Architecture] + [Warm Monochromatic Palette] + [Top-Aligned Geometric Display Type]
